property_summary: For any sender and any value, calling addToBalance() increases that sender's stored userBalance by exactly the sent msg.value (i.e., new balance == old balance + msg.value); the mutant that overwrites balance with msg.value breaks this for inputs where the sender already has a nonzero balance.
change_summary: Remove the addition and instead set userBalance[msg.sender] to msg.value (overwrite rather than accumulate), changing the stored balance after addToBalance.
